subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo / technical deep dive with FinPath
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lowe <jordan.lowe@finpath.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: next steps + demo

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great to learn more about FinPath's roadmap for embedding AI into your customer workflows. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary use case: intelligent document ingestion + automated reconciliation for small-business accounts.
- Key constraints: PII handling, on-prem connector for certain customers, predictable latency for batch processing.
- Success metrics: 30% reduction in manual reconciliation time and <$0.003/token target on production workloads.

Next step: we'd like to schedule a technical deep dive / demo with our solutions and security folks to walk integration, network requirements (VPC/on-prem), and our SOC2 controls. Proposed 60–75 minute slots:

- Tue, Aug 25, 2026 — 10:00–11:15 PT
- Wed, Aug 26, 2026 — 13:00–14:15 PT

Can you confirm which of those works, or share 2–3 alternative windows? If helpful, please loop in your security and procurement contacts — I'll include our security engineer and solutions engineer on the invite once we lock time.

Attached: redwood-onepager.pdf and a short mutual action plan template to align success criteria.

Talk soon,

—Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
Attachment: redwood-onepager.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: FinPath_MutualActionPlan.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: next steps + demo

Hi Marissa,

Appreciate the recap — that aligns with what we discussed. Both of those slots look promising. I can do Tue Aug 25 at 10:00 PT.

Looping in Anita Shah (anita.shah@finpath.com) from our security team and procurement (procurement@finpath.com) so they can confirm any compliance/procurement prerequisites. Anita, our main asks are around SOC2 scope, data residency, and any on-prem connector requirements.

If you can send a calendar invite for Tue 8/25 at 10 PT that includes the technical agenda, we’ll confirm on our side.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Lowe

jordan.lowe@finpath.com

Agenda (proposed):
1) 15 min: short product demo focused on ingestion and reconciliation flows
2) 30 min: technical deep dive (integration, VPC/on-prem options, latency expectations) — will be led by our solutions engineer Dev Patel
3) 15–20 min: security & compliance Q&A — led by Aditya Rao

Aditya and Dev — I’ve added you on the invite so you can prep for network/connector questions and our SOC2 scope. Jordan — attaching the calendar invite and the mutual action plan so we can capture owners and deliverables ahead of the call.

Thanks — I’ll join Tue 8/25. Quick note for Anita / procurement: I attached a redacted SOC2 summary and a link to our compliance docs that cover data residency, encryption-in-transit & at-rest, and our audit practices. If you have a security questionnaire (SSQ) or specific network diagrams you want us to review beforehand, send them over and I’ll prioritize.

Also: on the on-prem connector, we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and can discuss options during the deep dive.
